summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Sportradar Group AG reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on May 20, 2026. The filing details shareholder votes on standard agenda items including approval of financial statements, compensation report, sustainability report, appropriation of earnings, discharge of directors and management, and re-election of ten board members. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no transactional or extraordinary event.
